title: Assignments satisfying a list of equations
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set, and let each row in a finite list of equations assign a coefficient in the field $ br/2 br$ to every element of $V$ and have a constant in that field. An assignment $x:V\to\bbr/2\bbr$ satisfies the list if it satisfies every equation that occurs in it.
